What's New!

ATTENTION: Beginning October 23, the Idaho Courts will implement updated fees for mailing physical copies of court documents through the U.S. Postal Service. These adjustments reflect recent USPS rate increases and apply only to physical mail services. Electronic service of documents is not affected.

The updated fees are as follows:

  • Standard envelope (1–4 pages): $1.15 (previously $1.05)
  • Large envelope (5–9 pages): $2.55 (previously $2.40)
  • Large envelope (10–25 pages): $5.80 (previously $5.55)
  • Large envelope (26–50 pages): $11.05 (previously $10.75)
  • Certified mail (small claims service only): $11.35 (previously $10.10)
  • Registered mail: $20.90 (previously $18.60)
  • Restricted delivery (optional; small claims service only): $14.65 (previously $12.75)

Clean Slate Act

Petition to Shield Records from Public Disclosure (Idaho Supreme Court Website)

Starting Jan. 1, 2024, the Clean Slate Act will allow people convicted of certain nonviolent, non-assaultive offenses to ask a court to shield their cases from public view. The Clean Slate Act can be found in Idaho Code section 67-3004(11).

New Idaho Legal Aid Statewide Phone Number

On July 17, 2019 all Idaho Legal Aid offices and hotlines can be reached by calling one statewide number: 208-746-7541. Calling the old numbers will automatically forward callers to the new statewide number.
